title: RiderEvent
description: One structured update from a delivery rider speaking Hinglish on a noisy phone line. Synthetic orders only: order_id is a short token, never a phone number.

order_id.description: Short synthetic order token such as "18". Null when the rider did not say one. Never a phone number.

eta_minutes.description: Minutes the rider quoted, if any.

confidence.description: Skeleton rules use 0.5 on a match and 0.0 otherwise. The LLM issue may replace this with a model score.
